warranty.title: Warranty & Product Protection
warranty.heroCopy: Designed to support your recovery with confidence. Our warranty covers manufacturing defects and ensures you receive the quality care MGRM is known for.
warranty.coverageLimitedDesc: Protection against manufacturing defects in materials and workmanship.
warranty.coverageReplacementDesc: Eligible products repaired or replaced at MGRM's discretion.
warranty.coverageDefectsDesc: Coverage for defects discovered during normal, intended product use.
warranty.coverageSupportDesc: Dedicated assistance for sizing, fitting, and warranty claims.

limited-warranty.title: Limited Warranty
limited-warranty.content: MGRM Medicare products sold in India, Nepal, Sri Lanka, Malaysia, and Singapore carry a limited warranty against defects in materials and workmanship under normal use. This warranty applies only when products are purchased from authorized MGRM dealers or the official MGRM Medicare store.

exclusions.title: What Is Not Covered
exclusions.content: The warranty does not apply if the product was not purchased from an authorized dealer, has been altered in any way, or was not used according to the Wearing Instructions provided with the product. Accidental damage, neglect, improper assembly, or misuse are also excluded from coverage.

repair-replace.title: Repair or Replacement
repair-replace.content: At MGRM's sole discretion, defective products covered under this limited warranty will be repaired or replaced with an equivalent product. MGRM reserves the right to substitute products of equal or greater value if the original model is discontinued.

return-policy.title: Return Policy
return-policy.content: Non-warranty returns are accepted within 90 days from the date of delivery or purchase. Please inspect your order upon receipt and notify us of any errors within five working days. Prior authorization and an original order number are required for all returns.

return-conditions.title: Return Conditions
return-conditions.content: Credit or replacement is subject to inspection upon return. Altered, used beyond trial fitting, or discounted clearance items are non-returnable. Products must be returned in original packaging with all accessories and documentation included.

regions.title: Applicable Regions
regions.content: This warranty information applies to MGRM Medicare products sold in India, Nepal, Sri Lanka, Malaysia, and Singapore. For products purchased in other regions, please contact your local authorized distributor for region-specific warranty terms.
